mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns tend to decline over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 4%) creates a virtuous cycle, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to decreased economic output.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with declining INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, RSAFS growth rates are positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as increased retail sales reflect strong consumer demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly correlated with RSAFS growth (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (when both are rising) indicates a tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5%, signaling a very low unemployment rate, S&P 500 forward returns tend to increase over the next 5 trading days due to the strong labor market's positive impact on economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances with UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in HOUST (new housing starts) by more than 10% in 2 months, indicating strong demand for new housing, precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances with surging HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 5-year rolling window.
